name: Burewala

queries.query: Burewala Pakistan official cadastral parcel map GIS land records Punjab
queries.result: Found the official Punjab municipal GIS program page listing Burewala and the official Municipal Committee Burewala basemap PDF. The basemap visibly documents parcel boundaries, but no public parcel-feature API or safe native parcel IDs/full polygons were exposed.

queries.query: بورے والا پنجاب سرکاری کادستر زمین نقشہ اراضی ریکارڈ
queries.result: Official Urdu/Punjab land-record results identified PLRA/Punjab Land Records services and the Burewala municipal basemap. The public services describe land-record access and map infrastructure but did not provide an anonymous safe parcel-ID plus polygon response for Burewala.

registryBasis: A local municipal map is actually evidenced: the official Municipal Committee Burewala 2023-24 basemap, published through Punjab Municipal Development Fund Company’s GIS municipal program, identifies parcel boundaries and is signed by municipal officials. This evidences a local municipal mapping custodian, not an open cadastral parcel API or legal title registry.

officialSources.observation: Official Punjab municipal GIS program page listing Burewala among the 16 city GIS maps.

Official Burewala municipal basemap, version 1.5, April 2024, scale 1:10,000; legend includes Parcel Boundary, and the signature panel names the municipal GIS officer, Municipal Officer (I&S), and Chief Officer.
Official Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement map portal. Public page exposes ArcGIS infrastructure and states that complete parcel details require login; no Burewala parcel response was retained.
Official Punjab Land Records Authority site describing GIS-linked land-record services; no anonymous Burewala parcel geometry endpoint was identified.

source.name: Burewala Municipal Committee basemap
source.operator: Municipal Committee Burewala / Punjab Municipal Development Fund Company
source.method: Official web discovery and bounded anonymous GET inspection
source.scope: Municipal basemap showing parcel-boundary cartography; not a queryable parcel-feature dataset and not evidence of complete cadastral coverage.

requests.outcome: Direct anonymous request timed out in the bounded attempt; official search discovery independently identified the page and its Burewala listing.
Official PDF returned. It depicts parcel boundaries and municipal context, but provides no machine-readable parcel IDs or full parcel polygons suitable for safe GeoJSON retention.
Official municipal map index identified through first-party search results; no parcel API was exposed.

Public PULSE map page returned and its current JavaScript/configuration was inspected. It uses ArcGIS services under gismaps.punjab-zameen.gov.pk; the page explicitly says complete parcel details require login. No Burewala parcel layer was safely queried.
Public ArcGIS service inventory returned. No Burewala-specific open parcel service was identified; the visible GPC parcel service required a token.
ArcGIS returned Token Required. No token was used, and no feature query or geometry was retained.
Official Punjab Land Records search module returned, requiring interactive region/district/tehsil/village selection; no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was exposed.
Official PLRA site returned and described GIS-linked land-record services; no public Burewala parcel geometry was found.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Burewala municipal basemap and Punjab land-record/GIS channels investigated.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Municipal PDF cartography shows parcel boundaries; no safe machine-readable parcel identity plus full polygon response was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The municipal basemap does not establish parcel-level API coverage, native parcel identity, CRS, or citywide completeness. No claim is made about parcel absence, ownership, legal title, tax records, or completeness of PLRA/PULSE/internal datasets. Packet completion is not source integration or admission.
